body:
## What to build

**Priority: P2.** Resolve ordinary local summary selectors in the lexical scope in which they execute, while keeping complete-Grouping-plan keys and Contextual share outputs excluded as documented.

The investigation at main commit `28c449aa03fd5289916f0673e41c848cc126999e` found silent wrong-column selection. The input has grouping key g = a, a, b; integer x = 1, 2, 3; and double y = 5, 6, 7. The calling environment binds cols to y. A summary invokes an inline function whose own cols argument is x, and whose body applies across with all_of(cols) and sum. Ordinary dplyr returns column x with totals 3, 3. The Margin summary returns column y with totals 11, 7. Removing the outer binding makes only the Margin call fail with an object-not-found error.

The same scope loss affects pick, if_any, if_all, and a function-local type predicate. An across inside local also reproduces it. The deferred selection receives the original summary quosure environment instead of the active function/local evaluation scope. Tracing observed the callback's cols = x and the resolver's cols = y in the same execution. Literal-selection and matching-outer-binding controls succeed, and changing parentheses or adding an identity wrapper does not repair it.

The completed coverage loop exercised three local frame classes, fixed-key and rollup grouping, no share and unrelated Total/Parent shares where eligible, four selectors, and absent/matching/conflicting outer bindings: 180 cases, including 60 silent divergences, 60 missing-binding failures, and 60 successful matching-binding controls. A second investigator independently reproduced all four helpers.

The Contextual helper contract and ADR 0019 preserve ordinary lexical lookup for other names and preserve evaluation boundaries. This is distinct from the prior-summary mask visibility repaired by #604 and the first packed selection planning boundary repaired by #701.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An inline function selecting x returns the same ordinary summary columns and values as dplyr even when the enclosing environment binds the selector's name to y; removing that outer binding also succeeds.
- [ ] across, pick, if_any, if_all, and where predicates respect function arguments and locally created lexical bindings at execution. Cover a local-wrapped across as well as inline functions.
- [ ] Preserve the environments intentionally carried by injected quosures. A fix must distinguish an explicit captured environment from a newly created runtime scope.
- [ ] Cover ordinary summaries alone and beside unrelated Total and eligible Parent shares, with fixed keys and rollups and the supported local frame classes.
- [ ] Complete-plan grouping columns and prohibited earlier Contextual share dependencies remain excluded or refused. Source eligibility and cardinality rules are retained.
- [ ] Planning does not execute caller functions to guess a runtime scope. Public regressions cover both silent wrong answers and missing-binding failures, retain ordinary evaluation counts, and the Review-ready check passes before review.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Evidence

[Dated investigation and reproducible evidence](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/e447956b47b8d1e965ebc2bbec1333ed549b504a/investigation/summary-spec-total-share-bughunt-2026-10-30.md), published in [PR #1078](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1078). The PR records the investigation only and does not implement or close this ticket.
title: [P2] Resolve local summary selectors in their execution scope
